rationale: state-cost (registered by lane STATE-COST-PRODUCER, 2026-09-25 operator ruling 'build the producer' on state_cost_facts, docs/plans/data-machine-tool-gaps-2026-09-25.md): a single-pass producer harness, one run resolves a set of candidate state-level cost facts through the source registry, grounds each against a captured span, upserts the (state_code, dimension, fact_label) row, and mints jurisdiction entity-spine links for the states it touched.
